costScope: Whole recipient recognized resources, with event costs and donated-service reconciliation. Five latest-year budgets retained only in conditional reference; no gift-sensitive prospective tranche identified. Public and private implementation resources unpriced.
geographicAttribution: Only California-resident health within the finite window is counted. The retained alpha reference uses an analyst-selected 1.5 million older-adult cohort, not observed reach. California and Los Angeles are overlapping views of the same recipient and must not be added. Current beta population and exposure are unknown.
formula: h1=h0*exp(-ln(HR)/10*transport*pm); rho=ln(1.03); F(a,t)=(1-exp(-a*t))/a. qD=u*(F(h1+rho,T)-F(h0+rho,T)). a=min(A,T). qT=u*(F(h1+rho,a)-F(h0+rho,a)+(1-exp(-(h0-h1)*a))*(exp(-(h1+rho)*a)-exp(-(h1+rho)*T))/(h1+rho)). q=(f*qD+(1-f)*qT)/1.03^L. Qgift=10000/(E*Y)*b*(p*N*q-harm). Price=100000/Qgift if positive. N is cohort alive at implementation; no extra survival-to-implementation multiplier. Costs are constant-real full budgets; no cost discount haircut.
counterfactual: Existing grants, partner maintenance, adopted Clean Truck Check enforcement, signed September 2026 EV laws and the executed ports agreement/addendum continue as baseline unless evidence shows otherwise. For at-berth defense, compare preservation probabilities with and without a specifically funded CCA increment, including other advocates, litigation and alternative authority. For filtration, compare actual occupied indoor exposure with and without the new gift, not indoor versus outdoor concentration.
attribution: CCA authorship, supporting legislation, comments and historical wins establish activity only. Net gift-specific influence must include coalition substitution and replacement funding once. Neither a general support form nor an accounting deficit estimates it. Original p/b retained only in labeled alpha-reference cases.
uncertainty: Beta withdraws the rankable central because no measured/current marginal pathway anchors the generic policy assumptions. Null means unknown, not no benefit. Conditional values survive for auditability and threshold tests, not a recommendation. Preserve zero, clinical-null and harm cases.
nativeOutcomes: Additional annual ambient PM2.5 exposure reduction among an explicitly modeled older cohort; finite discounted all-cause survival differences, without adding overlapping mortality/morbidity or lead/IQ units.

sensitivity: Favorable/poor bundles vary several linked assumptions and are not probabilistic credible intervals.
Tenfold reduction in p increases price tenfold.
N and exposure are conditional on reform, not multiplied by total state population or total historic policy benefits.
Timing-only model compares gift and delayed-policy survival through the same finite endpoint.
Retained alpha diagnostics assume zero net omitted pathways; the beta does not validate that assumption, and harms can reverse a positive diagnostic result.

At-berth ten-QALY threshold: net gift-induced deltaP=10/B; B unestimated for the actual rule. Reusing alpha exposure as an illustrative immediate ten-year durable case requires 0.9465 percentage points, not demonstrated by an op-ed.

California and Los Angeles are overlapping views of the same recipient; no cross-edition summation. Do not add all-cause survival to overlapping cause-specific deaths, cancer, PM mortality or climate pathways.

Adverse cases include legal rollback, near-zero additional compliance, replacement by other funders, exposure relocation, generation or upstream fuel pollution, energy/transport affordability and reliability, and filter/ventilation failure. Their net health effect is not measured.
missingInputs: Named, costed unrestricted gift tranche and binding staff/consultant/filter capacity unavailable without it.
Current H.J.Res.210 disposition, alternative legal authority and how CCA changes survival/enforcement probability beyond other actors.
Rule-specific California resident exposure, pollutant mixture, age distribution, no-gift compliance and finite duration; no invented at-berth QALYs.
AirAware occupied person-hours, counterfactual indoor dose, maintenance and energy costs, partner replacement and post-grant funding.
Full incremental public/private implementation resources, adverse transport/energy effects and cross-program health overlap.
